text:
alex: Hey team — clearing out my desk before the move. Free to a good home: IKEA Bekant sit-stand desk (white, 160x80 cm), motorized, lightly used; plus two 24" Dell P2419H monitors (VESA, DP+HDMI), and one dual-monitor arm. Pickup in SOMA Friday or Saturday. Pics: https://imgur.com/xxxxxx

jina: Ooh tempting. dims? can a hatchback fit this or need a truck? :thinking_face:

alex: dims are 160 x 80 cm, height range ~65-125 cm. It breaks down into top + two legs and a crossbar. If you fold seats down, a hatchback can work but plan for two people. Weight ~40kg

marc: I can take the monitors only if they're still available. Saturday morning pickup works for me. @alex DM me details? :thumbsup:

alex: @marc you're first for the monitors. I'll hold them for you until 6pm TOMORROW. Please DM me your arrival window.

tina: if marc only wants monitors, is the dual arm included with the desk or is that a separate thing?
alex: arm is included with monitors (it's the arm that clamps to the desk). If marc takes just monitors+arm i'm fine with that.

sophie: If marc drops, i'd happily take the desk. I have a small van and can help disassemble. Also happy to split if folks want parts separately.

marc: DMed you @alex. happy to pick up 9-10am saturday. will bring a second person to help.

ops-bot: Friendly reminder: please coordinate personal item pickups during business hours and avoid leaving items in conference rooms.

alex: thanks @marc — monitors are on hold. Desk still available until EOD tomorrow, then i'll post again. If anyone wants the crossbar or cable tray separately lmk.

tina: If marc passes on the arm, i'll take it and can pay $20 for shipping if needed.

sophie: noted. if desk stands, i'll pick it up sunday and can bring a dolly.

alex: sweet — i'll update here after pickup. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

alex: Update — @marc picked up monitors this morning, arm included. Desk still available, posting pictures in thread: https://imgur.com/yyyyyy. If no takers by tomorrow evening i'll list on fb marketplace.

jina: Would you be open to delivering for a small fee if i pay? i can offer $30 + assembly help next week.
alex: Possibly — DM with address and we'll see. Thanks again for the interest, team!
